Expense Handbook

Receipts
Employees must attach a receipt for any expense greater than 25 US dollars. Expenses at or below 25 US dollars may be submitted without a receipt but still require a business purpose.

Travel
Domestic flights must be economy class. Hotel nightly rate may not exceed 180 US dollars unless a director approves an exception in writing.

Submission
Submit expense reports within 14 days after the trip ends. Late reports require finance review.
